reviews.text: A very successful dog eye surgery on August 27, 2026, performed by a specialist. We went home with confidence for further treatment with instructions.
I missed the receptionist, luckily I didn't get time, never again
Expensive
Friendly staff, 2 cats were happy. Triple vaccinations were given.

I have been going here with my cats for many years and the service has always been excellent and the staff seem to genuinely love animals. I also appreciate that the dentist also does any additional treatments during the check-up, so you don't have to make a second appointment. There is also a good eye specialist here.

I would like to ask politely if Dr. Sari Jalomäki will see you anywhere other than Apex? We would not like to lose her, a really pleasant and competent ophthalmologist. Unfortunately, we cannot say the same about another one. In addition, we have been fed up with that rude and really unpleasant receptionist here at Apex for years, having dealt with 3 dogs. 5 stars for Dr. Jalomäki, 1 star for other factors. Thank you in advance for the information and having just lost her old dog to a pain complication! Regards. Caroline Mamia Edit 03/2026: Ophthalmologists Anna Valtonen and Sari Jalomäki have moved to the small animal hospital Morelius in Vantaa. We also received friendly and competent help from Leena Ruotsalainen-Ryökky in Tammisto, Vantaa. So there is no need to advise a specialized ophthalmologist at Apex when he asks how others have performed the procedure. To top it all off, he took a dig when I told him that after refreshing the eye surface, Exocin drops were also prescribed in addition to Akvakol, and I kindly asked if we could get a prescription for it now, if the doctor thought it was necessary? He left the room without even saying goodbye. My old and fragile dog Betty had to be put down due to complications from pain and the flood of tears that followed the 15-minute eye rubbing that was choking her. HH: if you are a specialist and have to ask a client for advice on instrument choices, you can't afford to take a dig. I hope you never make an animal pay for your pride again.

I would give zero stars if possible.
I used it for a follow-up check-up of 14-year-old Demi's eye and ear check-up. The doctor examined Demi for about 15 minutes and then went to "write" the discharge instructions, which later turned out to be WRONG regarding the eyes. The instructions were copied from some old instructions. This writing and copying took about 20 minutes and the entire process cost 272 €. The operation was completely substandard and outrageously funded. I will never take my dog ​​to the Swedish venture capitalists' crooked company again. I DO NOT RECOMMEND!
Really rude and disgusting receptionist. Everything went well with the doctor, but this receptionist left a really bad impression. I will never go to Apex again.

My cat had teeth extracted and received very good care and recovered well from the operation. The only negative thing was that the cat had to wait several hours in a strange place alone before its turn, because it had to be brought there first thing in the morning.

The staff was friendly and professional.
The visit was unhurried and the cat's ailments were explained well.
Great place, good, professional service.

I no longer go to Evidensia. I moved back from Germany to Finland with a puppy and right at the reception the rude customer service person said loudly for everyone to hear that the dog is illegal even though this was not true at all. Then after the visit the woman continued to talk to me really rudely and pushed me to pay 550 euros for a tooth extraction for my dog ​​because it "has to be done immediately". I always get the feeling that they are just after money and the prices are absolutely ridiculous. I went elsewhere after this and paid 150 euros and the customer service person spoke to me respectfully and my dog ​​was not looked down upon since it was brought from abroad to Finland :)

A rude, insolent customer service representative on the phone, so aggressive that he almost started crying.
This visit also cost 400€, so they don't send any preparation instructions for the visit (a check-up visit for the animal's underlying disease, i.e. fasting was necessary), and the website doesn't provide general information either. So on top of that extortionate price, you still have to call and ask for preparation instructions yourself, which of course costs more money, including the wait. And if you don't know how to ask, you still have to pay for the visit but book another visit :D The money shines so brightly in your eyes that you can see it from afar. You would think that such an expensive clinic would even have a professional on customer service, but apparently we were wrong.
Evidensia's service is getting worse and more expensive every year, and now that aggressive customer service representative I spoke to on the phone this morning also treated my spouse (who went to the clinic with our pet) badly at the clinic counter because I had questioned on the phone that preparation instructions were not sent. 🙃 Malmin Apex used to have a good image thanks to veterinarian M.A., now was the last time we set foot in Malmin Apex.

We had a wonderful doctor and nurses taking care of our cat, who were able to take a blood sample even from a slightly restless cat. The customer service representative in the lobby was also really nice. Thank you very much!

We had really nice vets and our dogs were treated very well. We visited a couple of times and only treated the symptoms reliably and did not try to force additional tests. Very professional and customer-oriented service.
Appointments are very flexible, the place is well connected by public transport, there are parking spaces, the staff is professional, and the service is not compromised by the price 🙂 …
Expert veterinary service and the lameness problem was also treated.
Good and friendly service, we were even offered coffee/hot chocolate when we had to wait a while.
Huli the whippet received good and thorough treatment for sudden stomach problems! Friendly service!
Removal of a dog's baby teeth, the doctor was really good and knew how to handle the puppy well.
Friendly service and nice that you could buy the medicines directly during the same visit. I deducted one star because of the rather high price of the Veterinary Service.

This is the second time I've had my dog ​​here and the service has always been wonderful. I will definitely use Apex in the future. The care has always been friendly and the dog (and owners) have been taken care of extremely well.
Good service. Really friendly in every way.

A really nice ophthalmologist and calm nurse. Meeting a fearful dog was top-notch. Administering sedative medication without haste and without stressing the dog. During the procedure, up-to-date information about the situation and treatment tips. Finally, good home instructions and comprehensive medication.
Empathetic and caring care. There may be many opinions about Evidensia as a chain, but as a place it is top notch.

I used the dog as a suspected heart defect, when the guy pant for quite a long time after even a short walk. Well, that was recorded, as well as a few other senior dog ailments. But no solution or medication was found for any of the ailments. Is there a problem at the root of the tooth - so should I see a dentist about something? There was suspected wear and tear on the hip - so I'll take the dog for imaging and tests to see if he needs any medication? Heart murmur - so I'll take him to a cardiologist (this was a tip from the doctor). A strange and useless consultation visit, then. +200 € was needed for this (62 € for supplies and equipment - damn expensive rubber gloves). So in the future, we're already going there, so there must be a clear problem, they have been treated before. We can guess ourselves in the future....
The are genuine professionals.
Specialists in animal care work here, very friendly service, I recommend it. My very timid cat was comfortable here.
